title: The Brave Little Turtle
moral: Slow and steady wins the race.

scenes.text: Tim the turtle was walking slowly through the sunny meadow when he met Ricky the rabbit.
scenes.image_prompt: cute cartoon turtle meeting a smiling rabbit in a sunny meadow, colorful children's book illustration

scenes.summary: Rabbit challenges turtle to a race
scenes.text: The rabbit laughed and said he could run much faster than the turtle.
scenes.image_prompt: rabbit laughing and challenging turtle to a race, children's book style

scenes.text: The race started and the rabbit quickly ran far ahead while the turtle walked slowly.
scenes.image_prompt: rabbit running fast on a forest path while turtle walks slowly behind

scenes.summary: Rabbit gets tired and falls asleep
scenes.text: The rabbit got tired and decided to rest under a big tree.
scenes.image_prompt: rabbit sleeping under a tree while turtle slowly walks past

scenes.text: The turtle kept walking and finally crossed the finish line first.
scenes.image_prompt: happy turtle crossing finish line while rabbit wakes up surprised, children's book illustration

story: Once upon a time there was a small turtle named Tim. One day he met a rabbit who loved to run very fast. The rabbit laughed at the turtle's slow walking and challenged him to a race...
